command:
set -eu
BASE=/workspace/omega_runtime/extensions/ingress_v1
cd "$BASE"
PYTHONPATH=. python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
from omega.ingress_gateway import project
r=project(Path('/workspace/omega_runtime/state'),Path('/workspace/omega_runtime/data/omega_unified.db'),'gabriel','omega-vps','GRID TITAN cognitive organs')
print('CONTEXT_PROJECTION',{'db_read_success':r['db_read_success'],'records':len(r['records']),'grid':r['grid'],'context_digest':r['digest'],'effect_authority':r['effect_authority']})
assert r['db_read_success'], 'canonical database unreadable'
assert r['grid'].get('frame'), 'canonical GRID live status missing'
PY
umask 077
mkdir -p /workspace/omega_runtime/private /workspace/omega_runtime/state/logs
if tmux has-session -t omega-ingress 2>/dev/null; then
 echo 'GATEWAY_SESSION_ALREADY_PRESENT'
else
 tmux new-session -d -s omega-ingress "cd $BASE && PYTHONPATH=. exec python3 -m omega.ingress_gateway serve --owner gabriel --machine omega-vps --port 8787 >> /workspace/omega_runtime/state/logs/ingress_gateway.log 2>&1"
 echo 'GATEWAY_SESSION_CREATED'
fi
sleep 2
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import json,urllib.request,urllib.error
token=Path('/workspace/omega_runtime/private/ingress-gabriel.token').read_text().strip()
url='http://127.0.0.1:8787/v1/health'
r=urllib.request.Request(url,headers={'Authorization':'Bearer '+token})
with urllib.request.urlopen(r,timeout=4) as resp:print('AUTHORIZED_HEALTH',resp.status,resp.read().decode())
try:
 urllib.request.urlopen(url,timeout=4)
except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
 print('UNAUTH_HEALTH',e.code)
 assert e.code==401
else:raise AssertionError('auth bypass')
PY
